description: The Green Hydrogen Tube Trailer Driver will drive specialized tube trailers efficiently on the assigned route and fulfil critical fuelling needs for a sustainable future. The individual will be responsible for safely transporting Green Hydrogen, complying with strict safety regulations and procedures. This role requires the individual to possess relevant technical skills to handle most of the routine breakdowns that could likely be encountered while driving long distances and through various terrains. The individual is also expected to achieve key performance parameters like fuel efficiency, on-time delivery, etc.
